title: Octave Filter
text: Octave-band and fractional octave-band filter, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Mask for attenuation limits} sets Create a; {Filter order} sets the order of octave filter, {Center frequency (Hz)} sets the center frequency of octave filter, {Bandwidth} sets the filter bandwidth in octaves, {Oversample the input by 2 for this filter} sets the oversample toggle, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run, {Visualize filter response} sets the open plot to visualize magnitude response and compliance mask, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists} and {Export filter to workspace}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CF
ports.summary: Center frequency (Hz) scalar in the range 3 to 22,000 inclusive

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of octave filter 6 (default) | even integer

params.name: Center frequency (Hz)
params.values: Center frequency of octave filter 1000 (default) | scalar in the range 3 to 22,000 inclusive

params.name: Bandwidth
params.values: Filter bandwidth in octaves 1 octave (default) | 2/3 octave | 1/2 octave | 1/3 octave | 1/6 octave | 1/12 octave | 1/24 octave | 1/48 octave
